growth_signal.value: Annualized revenue grew from about $492M in May 2026 to $900M in September 2026.

entry.idea: Writing and maintaining software still takes armies of engineers, so Cognition built an AI agent called Devin that can work through coding tasks on its own, from planning a fix to writing, testing and shipping the code.
entry.lesson: Once an AI model can reliably finish multi-step tasks, package it as an autonomous agent for one expensive, well understood job instead of a general chat tool.
entry.name: Cognition

growth.reason: Annualized revenue nearly doubled in about four months, from $492M to $900M.

market.reason: Software engineers work in nearly every industry worldwide, so an AI that does their job has a huge potential market.

tech.reason: Devin's autonomous, multi-step coding is a real edge today, but strong rivals in AI coding tools could catch up within a year or two.

entry.twist: Devin is built to act like a full teammate that plans and finishes multi-step engineering work by itself, not just a code-autocomplete tool.
entry.who_pays: Software companies pay to use Devin as an AI engineer to help their teams ship code.
entry.why_now: AI models recently got good enough to handle long, multi-step tasks on their own, which is exactly what real software engineering work requires.
